Notion SQL query quota (workspace usage limit for Query Data Source) was hit mid-run, after all item-producing queries for this run had already succeeded, while fetching a supplementary url-only export of the full 198-row Tactical Tasks List for complete snapshot reconciliation. extensions.notion.snapshot.tactical_tasks_list is therefore the prior snapshot unioned with only the ~35 urls this run can confirm precisely (today's individually-shown stale items + meeting action items), not the full 198 open rows -- safe because the union never drops a key and tactical staleness is recomputed fresh from Notion every run (no dedup logic depends on this snapshot's completeness), but flagging so a future run doesn't assume it's exhaustive.
